# Code of Conduct

Design Frontier is an open technical project. Participate honestly, respectfully and without harassment. Discuss the work, not the worth of the person proposing it.

Unacceptable conduct includes personal attacks, discriminatory language, intimidation, deliberate disruption and publication of private information.

Maintainers may edit, hide or remove contributions that breach these rules and may restrict participation when necessary. Reports can be sent privately through the security contact documented in `SECURITY.md` until a dedicated conduct address exists.
